create_NashRandomSearch: create a NashRandomSearch instance to randomly search for a Restricted Nash Equilibrium in a mean-field game
compute_exploitability: compute the exploitability of a given policy distribution nu against a set of policies
run_NashRandomSearch_step: run the step method to iterate random policy distributions and minimize exploitability
get_nu_distribution: get a random probability distribution over policies using softmax of normal samples
reset_NashRandomSearch: reset the NashRandomSearch bandit with a new set of policies and clear internal state
